_comment: Put a real contact address in "contact" (in an install this file is secrets/app/musicbrainz.json; setup copies it there). MusicBrainz policy (NFR-14) requires requests to identify the application and provide a way to reach whoever is making them. The app FAILS TO START without this rather than sending anonymous traffic — being unidentified while believing you are compliant is worse than a loud refusal. secrets/ is gitignored; this example is the only file in it that is committed.
